g.text: Bode factors add gain, pole, and zero contributions in decibels

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: First-order minimum-phase factors. Each pole contributes −atan(ω/ωp), each zero +atan(ω/ωz), and positive real gain contributes zero phase. Dashed
magnitude uses straight-line approximations; exact magnitude differs near the corners.
